items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: They had, uh, one time when I heard them, they had, uh, Jimmy Noon on the clarinet. They had Buddy Petit on the cornet.

ctx.x: That's, that's, that's many years back. Gee whiz. Um. Now they had some very good bands. I mean, uh, came behind this band like, uh, the Yama Lipi Band. Well, that band was terrific. It was in there. Yeah, that band was really a mess of me. They, they, they was better than those bands. Well, I got, just got through calling. It was in there. It was in there. It was really in there. They had, uh, they had, uh, Simon Marrero on the bass. They had John Marrero on the guitar. They had, uh, one time when I heard them,…
Did you ever hear the... It's a good band though. Yeah. The T.O.s much? On the clarinet?

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: I was playing a pick-need with Basia and Buddy Petit out there, out the lake

ctx.x: You're gonna leave out about that? I'ma lead it out on the lake there. I'll tell you about what they did to him. I don't know. I was playing a pick-need with Basia and Buddy Petit out there, out the lake, I forget who I was in that band. And some guys from Irish Channel had hired us. And while we was on the mission, the guy took all our coats and tied them all in and not, man. And put them back on the chair where we had over there. Tied them all in and not, boy. Got this some... Did you work in the channel?
Huh? You ever work in the channel much?
